title: Not Everything Is Deny
agent_message: I can update a pinned helper library in a sandbox, run local checks, and show the diff before touching the demo branch.

context.label: dependency note
context.content: The requested version is pinned and the agent proposes a local test database, not production data.

inspect_artifacts.label: Bounded plan
inspect_artifacts.content: The plan uses sandbox execution, a pinned dependency, local test data, diff inspection, and eval before release.

approve.consequence: A dependency changed without the promised sandbox and eval trail.
approve.lesson: Even allowed work needs the bounded path that made it allowed.
approve.safer_alternative: Approve only the sandboxed, pinned, inspected, eval-backed path.

deny.consequence: Safe bounded work stopped, and the team learned to fear all agent action.
deny.lesson: Mature safety is bounded execution, not blanket refusal.
deny.safer_alternative: Allow sandboxed work with pinned dependency, diff review, and eval.

inspect_diff.consequence: The diff will be visible, but the execution boundary still matters.
inspect_diff.lesson: Inspection is one layer in a bounded permission stack.
inspect_diff.safer_alternative: Inspect after the sandbox run and before final approval.

run_in_sandbox.consequence: The agent learned safely without touching production-like state.
run_in_sandbox.lesson: Sandboxing is the right first move for bounded dependency work.
run_in_sandbox.safer_alternative: Run sandbox checks, inspect the diff, then require eval before release.

require_eval.consequence: The dependency change had to prove it did not break the demo path.
require_eval.lesson: Safe speed includes evidence before release.
require_eval.safer_alternative: Require eval after sandbox and diff inspection.

restrict_scope.consequence: The agent stayed inside the pinned helper and local test data boundary.
restrict_scope.lesson: Scoped access lets useful agent work proceed.
restrict_scope.safer_alternative: Restrict to one pinned package and local test fixtures.

escalate_reviewer.consequence: A reviewer confirmed the bounded path but slowed a safe change.
escalate_reviewer.lesson: Escalation is acceptable when the dependency risk is unclear.
escalate_reviewer.safer_alternative: Escalate only if sandbox or eval evidence is ambiguous.

rollback.consequence: The change had a recovery path, but still needed sandbox and eval evidence.
rollback.lesson: Rollback is a guardrail, not a substitute for validation.
rollback.safer_alternative: Keep rollback ready after sandbox, diff, and eval pass.

facilitator_notes: Ask players to explain why this level should not be denied even though it changes a dependency.
